messages:
anna (Sales): Heads-up @leo @maya: Nova wants a short POC for a 30B variant next week. They mention a custom tokenizer that reindexes IDs + LoRA adapters. Need: catalog fit, tokenizer mapping plan, quant/kv compatibility check, and a POC quote (reserved infra for 1 week). Can we triage today?

leo (Solutions Eng): Please share model bundle and sample prompts. Need avg tokens, peak qps, and any custom ops. Quick flags: reindexed tokenizer may break caching/embeddings; 3k tails will stress KV cache; LoRA+int8 needs validation.

anna (Sales): Link: s3://nova-poc/variants/nova-llama30b-lora-v3.tar.gz (IAM coming). Workload: avg ~300 tokens, peak 12 rps, ~5% requests at ~3k seq. No custom CUDA noted in doc.

maya (Security): Ask Nova for BYOK requirement, data residency, and whether weights contain customer PII. Also need SOC2/contact for MSA. For POC we default to Redwood-managed KMS unless they require BYOK.

kevin (AE): For pricing, propose 1-week reserved pool + per-token overage. Rough calc: sustained 8 rps * 300 toks ~8.6M tokens/day. I'll sketch numbers but need confirmed sustained throughput.

ingest-bot: ingest: queued model-scan for s3://nova-poc/variants/nova-llama30b-lora-v3 job=scan_20270418_02

customer_lin (Nova): Thanks team  IAM shared and I uploaded 10 validation prompts. We'll reply on BYOK/ residency shortly.
